_note: Book-level base colours. Every chapter spec copies these verbatim for any speaker it assigns; new minor speakers may be added in a chapter spec only. Register separates the ear collisions: Coss (clipped, formal) vs Doss (slow, gravelly); Darrow (low, heavy) vs Marrow (quick, oily-cheerful); Dessa (flat, level) vs Ressa (warm); Halvern and Halden never share a scene.
Cael: same narrator, a little younger and plainer for Cael; quiet, exact, holding himself level.
Hesk: same narrator, older and dry for Hesk; slow, warm under a gruff surface, an instrument-maker's precision.
Lira: same narrator, lighter and quicker for Lira; bright, direct, teasing at the edges, never soft.
Vell: same narrator, low and measured for Vell; spare, exact, a ledger-keeper weighing each word.
Torvin: same narrator, broad and easy for Torvin; warm, unhurried, a lodging-keeper's plainness.
Yeni: same narrator, quick and dry for Yeni; brisk, amused, needle-sharp.
Coss: same narrator, clipped and formal for Coss; level, careful, every word filed; never unkind.
Doss: same narrator, slow and gravelly for Doss; an old watchman's patience, few words.
Darrow: same narrator, low and heavy for Darrow Innes; deliberate, grounded, calm power, no boast.
Marrow: same narrator, quick and genial for Marrow the bookmaker; oily-cheerful, always counting.
Feryn: same narrator, steady and wry for Feryn; easy confidence, a veteran's kindness.
Dessa: same narrator, flat and level for Dessa; blunt, controlled, no warmth shown.
Ressa: same narrator, warm and quick for Ressa the baker; homely, cheerful.
Ilsev: same narrator, precise and cool for the assessor Ilsev; formal, fair, quietly impressed.
Halden: same narrator, soft and dry for Halden the reading-room keeper; bookish, slow.
Halvern: same narrator, brisk and official for the clerk Halvern; procedural, a little bored.
Joren: same narrator, young and eager for Joren; quick, warm, a little loud.
Garrik: same narrator, rough and practical for Garrik the cart-mender; gruff, matter-of-fact.
Pellin: same narrator, official and tidy for the Warden-Adjunct Pellin; courteous, careful.
Renn: same narrator, sharp and cocky for Renn; quick, needling.
Brenna: same narrator, firm and solid for Brenna; plain, stubborn, fair.
Kestrel: same narrator, hard and impatient for Kestrel; clipped, dismissive.
Corbin: same narrator, stiff and correct for Corbin; a rule-keeper's precision.
Corvane: same narrator, old and wheezy-warm for Corvane; slow, fond, a retired fighter's memory.
Sarel: same narrator, cool and quick for Sarel; light, confident.
Talis: same narrator, heavy and slow for Talis; few words.
Sella: same narrator, sharp and motherly for Sella; practical, scolding kindly.
OldMan: same narrator, old and unhurried for the old yard-owner; gentle, sparing, every word earned.
Boy: same narrator, lighter and younger for an errand boy or child; quick, cheeky.
